What is original Kalamkari, where to buy traditional kalamkari sarees/ original kalamkari fabric? I will share the whole process of creating a hand-painted Kalamkari from Srikalahasthi.
I visited Srikalahasthi recently to record this documentary. The whole point of this initiative is to help the artisan and make you understand what the original Kalamkari is.
This video will defiantly help you learn some important details about the craft.
